records.title: Waste Disposed Of And Recycled, Annual
records.dataSource: MINISTRY OF SUSTAINABILITY AND THE ENVIRONMENT, NATIONAL ENVIRONMENT AGENCY
records.footnote: Year 2020 was an anomalous year with lower waste generation and recycling rates due to the impact of COVID-19, particularly during the Circuit Breaker period (April to May 2020) when activities were curtailed. The pick-up in economic activity and resumption of business and social activities since 2021 has led to an increase in waste generated, disposed of and recycled.

row.footnote: Comprises incinerable waste that are sent to the incineration plants and non-incinerable waste that are sent directly to Semakau Landfill.  Data from 2015 exclude metals recovered from incineration bottom ash in a metal recovery facility that is commissioned in 2015.
Refers to waste collected from households and trade premises (e.g., shophouses, educational institutions, petrol stations, hawker centres and places of worship).
Refers to waste generated at industrial and commercial premises.
Refers to waste recovered and processed at local recycling facilities or exported overseas for recycling.
